sayLines.line: Enzo is staying at Haven as the camp healer now — tending the sick instead of ranging out.
“You’re right.” Enzo doesn’t look up. “I wasn’t programmer. I was army medic. I’m sorry — I wanted a cleaner story than I had.” The fire lets it land. Someone passes Enzo the bowl without a word.
Fyodor came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.

You have Lockjaw. Lockjaw — bacteria from rust and dirt, settled into a wound. Without real treatment it kills. Antibiotics end it; skilled wound care (triage, field medicine) can turn it — but only if you know what you're treating. (Antibiotics would end it.) The ruins to the west sometimes still hold medicine cabinets — worth searching. — diagnosed by Enzo.
⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
Sanne came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
Elif came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
(Learned: Haven can REQUEST aid from linked villages — food, medicine, hands. Find it on the Haven panel, under your links.)
Thabo came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Enzo Wojcik, 46 — an army medic. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Echo Location, Beard Moss, Loud Chewer.
Onni is staying at Haven as the camp healer now — tending the sick instead of ranging out.
The System notes the synergy — healed someone back from the brink: +2 craft XP.
Luis came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
